The short version: Euka is an all-in-one TikTok Shop affiliate platform, discovery through payout, for roughly $159 to $479 a month, and you operate it. Tokgency is a managed agency that runs that lifecycle for you and is measured on GMV. Both target the same outcome. The difference is who does the daily work.

The catch with any all-in-one platform is that it still needs an operator running a real system. One TikTok Shop seller summed up what that system looks like: "1 to 3 hero products, a strong TikTok-exclusive offer, competitive creator commissions, consistent sample outreach, clear hooks, not rigid scripts" (@jordantwestecom on X). Euka gives you the dashboard; someone still has to run that loop every day.

What Euka is

Euka is a capable AI-powered TikTok Shop affiliate platform. It offers:

  • AI creator search across a 3.5 to 4M+ creator database
  • Automated outreach, sampling, and payouts in one place
  • Campaign management and an AI store copilot
  • Platform-wide proof points like $4B+ GMV and thousands of stores

Pricing is roughly $159/mo (Starter) to $479/mo (Growth). It is a strong single-login system if you have someone to run it.

What Tokgency is

Tokgency is TikTok-only and done-for-you. We handle recruiting, seeding, negotiation, briefs, management, ads, and reporting, and we own the GMV number. The creator finder is there if you want to search yourself, but the core is a managed service.

Side by side

Euka Tokgency
Model All-in-one software Managed agency (+ tool)
Runs the daily ops You Us
Pricing ~$159 to $479/mo Flexible, commission-friendly
Proof Platform-wide GMV Your GMV
Best when You have an operator You want the outcome

One thing worth naming: Euka's headline proof is platform-wide GMV across thousands of stores. Impressive, but it is not your GMV. A managed program is accountable for the number on your dashboard specifically.

When Euka is the better pick

  • You want the whole lifecycle in one tool and have the time to run it.
  • You prefer in-house control end to end.
  • You are comfortable owning outreach, briefs, and scaling decisions.

When Tokgency is the better pick

  • You want a program run for you, not another login.
  • You are stuck scaling and need operators, not more software.
  • You want fees that can align with GMV rather than a flat seat.

Software assumes you supply the operator. If that person exists and has the hours, Euka is a solid choice. If not, the platform becomes a subscription that underperforms. For the full framing, see DIY, software, or agency.

Want to know which fits you? Book a call for an honest read, or search creators in your niche to start.
